name: commerce/sale-countdown
title: Sale countdown
description: A real campaign deadline alongside currently discounted public catalog products.

ai.useFor: A dated sale campaign backed by actual catalog sale prices. Use the real campaign deadline; omit it for an undated sale selection.
ai.avoid: Never fabricate urgency or reset the deadline. Only current public discounted products are shown. A campaign deadline does not alter product sale prices or checkout eligibility.
